title: Review fixes: print kit and words (REP-122), kit rebuilt at rules 20

scope: Print: C-03 one money rule at the table (DEC-108); C-04 coloured bands; C-05 "an apple"; C-06 Blueberry Glut's market price; C-08 badge colour and picture; C-09 what counts as fruit sold, with a tally on the counter card; C-10 Free Fruit does not count toward the 4 pieces; C-11 a note on the board and shutters; C-18 small slips

Words: C-02 standing orders only when they can be collected; C-13 "Daily market" on Home; C-14 and S16 the evening tip; C-16 Daily wording; C-19 the day-chip rule; C-20 records and code notes; ON-11 RULES.md on choosing shopkeepers; S15 the Charmer's favour-card limit
Print kit, update pack and tracker tests rebuilt at rules 20 (after PLAN-108)
exclusions: C-17: the event footer "Lasts until night" stays (owner: No)
